input.expectedText: 本次实验是对74LS181运算器的开关操作方式的实验，主要是通过手动拨动开关，验证其算术和逻辑运算的功能。与我们第一个做的键盘方式的实验相比，这次的实验方式需要我们一步步地拨动开关输入数据和指令。

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.description: Read the current Word document structure, counts, diagnostics and revision without modifying it.

tools.name: list_document_regions
tools.description: List one bounded page (maximum 80) of stable document nodes and short text previews. limit MUST be an integer from 1 to 80. Use offset for pagination; never request limit greater than 80 or the entire document unless necessary.

tools.name: read_document_region
tools.description: Read the current text for one stable paragraph or table-cell node.

tools.name: inspect_node_capabilities
tools.description: Read the supported, guarded or unsupported operations for one semantic document node without modifying it.

tools.name: plan_text_change
tools.description: Dry-run one exact text replacement and return the targets, changed parts, risk and validation diagnostics. This never writes the document and does not require approval.

tools.name: apply_text_change
tools.description: Apply one exact text replacement to a paragraph or table cell after the user approves it. Creates one immutable derived document version.

tools.name: apply_text_changes
tools.description: Atomically apply two to thirty exact text replacements to known paragraph or table-cell nodes. Validates every target first, then creates one immutable derived version. Use this for a bounded multi-location edit.

tools.name: list_source_documents
tools.description: List the task's uploaded source documents and their roles (template, example, or auxiliary). This never changes the Working Document.

tools.name: read_source_document
tools.description: Read one uploaded source document's structure and text for comparison. The source role is included so template, example and auxiliary material stay distinct; this never modifies a document.

tools.name: inspect_image
tools.description: Read and analyze one selected document image when the task depends on its visual content. Returns structured visual facts, never image bytes or URLs.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate a private image asset. Use references for similar or edit requests; this never modifies the Word document.

tools.name: replace_document_image
tools.description: Replace one existing Word image with a generated private asset. This creates a new immutable document version and requires approval.

tools.name: capture_document_view
tools.description: 只捕获当前 Working Document 的可视区域，并返回一个 screenshot asset；它本身不执行视觉理解。如果需要判断排版、图片、表格、重叠、对齐等视觉内容，截图成功后继续调用 inspect_image，source=asset，assetId 使用截图结果。普通文本内容应优先使用文档读取工具。

tools.name: scroll_document_view
tools.description: 只移动当前 Working Document 的浏览视口，不读取文档、不截图、不执行 Vision、不修改 DOCX、不产生 Document Version。滚动后如需观察新区域，请继续调用 capture_document_view，再调用 inspect_image。到达 atBottom=true 或 atTop=true 时不要继续向该方向滚动。视觉浏览长文档时应按 capture_document_view → inspect_image → scroll_document_view → capture_document_view → inspect_image 的顺序进行。

tools.name: list_document_versions
tools.description: List immutable versions of the current Word document, including the active version, origin, revision and creation time. Read-only.

tools.name: export_document
tools.description: Export the current immutable document version and return a short-lived download URL. This does not modify document content.

tools.name: restore_document_version
tools.description: Restore a selected immutable document version by creating a new restore version. The source version is never overwritten and this action requires user approval.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: 当缺少继续执行所必需的信息时，向用户提出一个明确问题并暂停当前对话。
